purpose: Carry the closed Stability Arc scalar-modal reporting discipline into future chemistry results without changing any already-frozen chemistry scientific setting, threshold, method, or conclusion.

does_not_retroactively_modify: CO/Cu(111) frozen Stage A or clean-surface/site-ordering protocols
H/Ru(0001) frozen System 3 method and quantum-treatment protocol

required_reporting_object.G: governing generator, Hessian/dynamical object, response operator, or explicitly justified reduced model
required_reporting_object.s: licensed scalar coordinate set and applicable competing margins
required_reporting_object.V: modal, eigenvector, tangent, reaction-coordinate, or subspace geometry
required_reporting_object.C: explicit scalar-to-mode/subspace assignment and correspondence rule
required_reporting_object.R: inter-channel or cross-description relation when more than one legitimate dynamical description is present
required_reporting_object.U: uncertainty, conditioning, provenance, admissibility, and refusal state

allowed_when: the physical carrier is an identified stable second-order damped mode with physically meaningful Gamma and Omega
an independently admitted real stable 2D quotient licenses an equivalent chi-type invariant
mandatory_companions: modal/eigenvector or subspace representation when numerically available
neighboring-mode or degeneracy information where material
forbidden_shortcuts: selecting a mode because its chi is nearest 1
reporting a system-wide chi when multiple physically distinct modes are unresolved
using well-side chi as barrier-local friction
treating chi=1 as a rate optimum, mean-square boundary, or saddle-point criticality without an independent derivation

barrier_and_rate_boundary.rule: Barrier height, reaction rate, damping morphology, rate turnover, barrier transmission, exceptional-point proximity, and friction regime remain distinct quantities unless a separately frozen comparison establishes a relation.
barrier_and_rate_boundary.barrier_coordinate: An inverted scalar barrier mode has no real critical-damping boundary; use the appropriate reactive-pole/transmission description rather than manufacturing a mechanical chi at the saddle.
barrier_and_rate_boundary.barrier_atlas_v0_9: No retroactive change required. The frozen v0.9 Atlas already forbids well-side ChemSA chi from substituting for barrier-local friction and all 61 frozen coordinates record well_chi_used_for_rate=false.

multimode_and_memory_rule.if_coupled_or_non_normal: carry the full relevant generator plus modal geometry and all required scalar margins; do not force a single scalar
multimode_and_memory_rule.if_frequency_dependent_friction_or_memor: do not collapse a kernel to one Gamma unless a separately justified projection/reduction licenses it
multimode_and_memory_rule.if_mode_correspondence_changes: freeze the correspondence rule before inspecting the target outcome
multimode_and_memory_rule.if_nonidentifiable: return a refusal/nonidentifiable state rather than selecting the most favorable scalar

system_specific_application.CO_Cu111_System2: Current clean-surface and site-ordering work is upstream of any promoted stability scalar and is unchanged. Any later reaction-coordinate/friction/ChemSA result must satisfy this reporting contract before promotion.
system_specific_application.H_Ru0001_System3: The existing frozen protocol already requires reaction-coordinate matching, refuses chi until dissipation validators pass, and requires independently sourced projected friction. If later eligible for ChemSA, the final promoted record must additionally carry the explicit modal/subspace representation and scalar-to-mode assignment required here.
system_specific_application.Na_Cu001_development_pilot: Historical development use remains development evidence unless independently brought under a new frozen promotion contract; do not retroactively promote it by filling missing fields after outcome inspection.

implementation_note.ChemSA_current_strength: The current engine already preserves authoritative spectra, indexed right eigenvectors, left/right response bases, mode geometry, conditioning states, scalar-reduction refusal, and separate mechanical modal factors.
implementation_note.future_reporting_gap_to_close: Before a future real-system mechanical chi is promoted, expose or persist the mass-normalized mechanical modal vector/subspace together with MechanicalModeRecord (or an equivalent external report object) so the scalar-to-carrier assignment is explicit rather than reconstructable only from internal computation.
implementation_note.preferred_route: additive reporting adapter or backward-compatible output extension; do not disturb the frozen ChemSA release merely to satisfy this future reporting requirement
